summary: CAIR Action endorsed Lieber for the California State Board of Equalization in the 2026 general, and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally. CAIR's 2024 guide, issued while she was a county-supervisor candidate, described her as an outspoken supporter of ceasefire and Palestinian rights, though the dates of those underlying statements are not recorded. Together these assessments place her in support of Palestinian justice.
